title: cutoffs reject: hmmer is the sole rejection judge

notes.author: jackroddy/21204bf1
notes.text: Implemented in the working tree, uncommitted: reject runs nail, mmseqs and hmmsearch over the reversals only and one hmmsearch judge over the originals at -Z = the shard's seqs from set.tbl (Layout refuses a set whose shards differ); learn subtracts the judge's E<=1e-3 pairs from every tool's reversal hits. Toy: fanout and union identical byte for byte, but the toy recruits nothing with nail or hmmer and the judge finds nothing (0918e6). sp-10k built and run in the sandbox under union: recruit 74 s, reject 166 s at 48 threads; judge 10,028 rows, 4,899 at E<=1e-3; 1,699 families, cutoffs for nail 1,278 / mmseqs 1,041 / hmmer 597, medians 11.2 / 24.0 / 13.5, against 1,715 / 1,292 / 1,071 / 620 and 11.3 / 24.0 / 13.6 on 28 Sep. Recruit is not deterministic across runs, so the two are not pair-for-pair comparable.
